purpose: Folhas de referência de identidade e expressões; assets de cena serão preparados na etapa 02.

sheets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: character MODEL SHEET for stage 01 of enGAN.AI, a visual identity reference for future implementation. Input image is the approved art direction and CHARACTER IDENTITY reference. Preserve the exact character face, body silhouette, clothing, props, materials, colors, scale and render quality from it. Matte tactile stylized 3D indie detective adventure, warm ivory robot casing, soft controlled studio lighting. Do not redesign the character or invent accessories. Make ONE clean sheet with FOUR isolated full-body poses of the SAME character in a spacious 2 by 2 grid. All four poses have the same proportions and camera scale. Real transparent background, no environment, no furniture, no ground plane, no rectangular backdrop, no labels, no text or numbers, no logo. Each complete pose fits its own quadrant with generous empty margins; no overlap, cropped feet, floating extra hands, or shared props between poses. These are expression/pose references, not an animation sprite sheet. Square canvas. ONLY FIFI, the artist robot on the LEFT of the reference. Exact muted plum hooded jacket with G patch, purple artist beret with palette, muted ivory body, dark face screen, coral LED eyes, small paintbrush. No Lupa and no detective clothing. Upper left: neutral welcoming standing pose, brush relaxed at side, clever soft smile. Upper right: thinking/investigating her own work, one hand near chin, brush in other hand, curious eyes. Lower left: delighted playful celebration, brush raised without leaving quadrant, joyful eyes. Lower right: surprised after being discovered, humorous slightly sheepish expression, open palm, never sad or aggressive. Same head shape, beret, hood and eyes in all poses. The expression should read through screen eyes and simple mouth, without human skin or hair. Fifi stays mischievous and friendly.
